Test Description: As System Admin, create, view, edit, deactivate a user via admin interface/workflow.
Expected Outcome: User lifecycle operations succeed and reflect immediately in listings; deactivated user cannot login.

Test Description: As System Admin, assign/modify a user role and then login as that user.
Expected Outcome: User is redirected to correct role dashboard and sees correct features.

Test Case: User Activity Logs Populate from Events
Test Description: Perform login/logout and key actions; check admin view of user activity logs.
Expected Outcome: Logs are created for actions and are visible/searchable to admin.

Test Description: Open system health page/widgets and verify metrics are returned/visible.
Expected Outcome: Health metrics render successfully and include the required monitoring categories.

Test Description: Simulate a critical condition (e.g., logged security event) and verify alerts appear.
Expected Outcome: Admin sees an alert in dashboard/alerts list.

Test Description: Perform order creation, payment submission/verification, and stock movement; inspect audit logs.
Expected Outcome: Audit logs include each critical operation with correct actor and timestamps.

Test Description: Filter audit logs by user/action/date range and verify results.
Expected Outcome: Filtering returns correct subset and does not error.

Test Description: Run retention/cleanup job or simulate retention window and verify old logs are handled per policy (if implemented).
Expected Outcome: Logs older than retention are archived/deleted according to policy; newer logs remain.

Test Description: Register a new user with role selection and then login.
Expected Outcome: Account created; login succeeds; user lands on role-specific dashboard.

Test Description: Login with valid credentials and attempt with invalid credentials.
Expected Outcome: Valid login succeeds; invalid login fails with safe error.

Test Description: Request password reset and complete reset using email token (mock email backend).
Expected Outcome: Reset completes; user can login with new password; old password fails.

Test Description: Authenticate then simulate inactivity beyond timeout and request a protected page.
Expected Outcome: Session expired; user is logged out/redirected to login.

Test Description: Attempt to access pharmacist/admin pages as sales rep and admin pages as non-admin.

Test Description: Login as each role and verify landing page.
Expected Outcome: Sales Rep→Sales dashboard; Pharmacist/Admin→fulfillment/inventory dashboard; System Admin→admin dashboard.

Test Description: Pharmacist/Admin creates a medicine with units_per_box, reorder point, and prescription flag; view details.

Test Description: Edit a medicine (price/units_per_box/stock) and inspect audit log.
Expected Outcome: Audit entry exists with editor and fields changed.

Test Description: Create order referencing a medicine; attempt to delete the medicine.
Expected Outcome: Delete blocked; user sees validation message.

Test Description: Search/filter medicines by name/category/manufacturer/status/prescription requirement/price range.

Test Description: Create category, assign medicines, then attempt deletion.
Expected Outcome: Deletion blocked when category has medicines; allowed when none.

Test Description: Create manufacturer, assign medicines, then attempt deletion.
Expected Outcome: Deletion blocked when manufacturer has medicines; allowed when none.

Test Description: Create order to reduce stock; cancel order to restore; fulfill order to finalize stock movement.
Expected Outcome: Stock updates correctly for each action; no negative stock.

Test Case: Manual Stock Adjustment via Stock Movement
Test Description: Pharmacist/Admin records stock movement (in/out/adjustment) with reference.
Expected Outcome: Stock changes reflect movement; movement record shows audit fields.

Test Description: Reduce stock to reorder point and open inventory dashboard.
Expected Outcome: Reorder alert is created, visible, and shows medicine/current stock/reorder point/recommendation.

Test Description: Open dashboard; verify totals (medicines, low stock, out of stock, recent movements, alerts) update after stock change.

Test Description: Add/update/remove/clear cart items using UI endpoints.

Test Case: Cart Count Badge Updates from API
Test Description: Add and remove cart items and call API used by nav badge.
Expected Outcome: total_items updates correctly and matches UI badge.

Test Description: Attempt to add more boxes/units than available stock.
Expected Outcome: Operation blocked; cart remains unchanged; user gets error.

Test Case: Create Order from Cart with Required Customer Data
Test Description: Convert cart into order with customer name/contact/address.
Expected Outcome: Order created; OrderItems created; confirmation shown.

Test Description: Attempt to create order with 6 distinct medicines.
Expected Outcome: Order creation blocked or limited with validation message.

Test Description: Create order with box quantities and units_per_box.
Expected Outcome: Totals match required formula; item totals and order total correct.

Test Description: Attempt to place order exceeding inventory.
Expected Outcome: Order blocked; stock unchanged.

Test Description: Create multiple orders and inspect order_number.

Test Description: Open order detail and verify order number/date, customer info, items/prices, status/payment, total, history timeline.

Test Description: Attempt Delivered when payment not Paid; then verify payment and set Delivered.

Test Description: After pharmacist updates status, sales rep refreshes/receives notification and sees updated status.

Test Description: Upload receipt and attempt access as unauthorized user.
